title: When the Mixtape Breaks
author: Lena Eriksen
blurb: Coral Ishikawa, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
